targets.old_statement: The handbook advises releasing the accelerator if a skid begins and using only light braking after control returns; steering technique requires the conditions and vehicle to be considered.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The handbook advises releasing the accelerator if a skid begins and using only light braking after control returns; steering technique requires the conditions and vehicle to be considered.
targets.statement: When a skid begins, ease off the accelerator, steer in the direction of the skid, and once vehicle control returns, brake lightly and steer toward a safe path.
